title_en: Method and system for air pollution management using ubiquitous sensor network
title_ko: 유비쿼터스 센서네트워크를 이용한 대기오염 관리 방법 및시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for managing air pollution using a USN(Ubiquitous Sensor Network) are provided to reduce time required for establishing a sensor network on the spot required for monitoring air pollution in real time and configuring an overall monitoring system. A USN(110) measures measurement data with respect to an exhaust density of air pollutants in a pertinent area, location information of a sensor node, state information, and surrounding environment information, collects them, and transmits them to a control center(130). A wired/wireless communication network(120) transmits the collected data to the remote control center(130). The control center(130) performs real time monitoring and remote management on the exhaust of air pollutants by using the data received from the USN(110), and if the control center(130) determines that pollutants are generated by more than a reference value upon measuring the exhaust density or if a certain measure should be taken on the spot, the control center(130) transmits abnormality detect information to a message center(140). The message center(140) transfers the information received from the control center(130) to residents or on-the-spot measures information to a user terminal of a worker on the spot, and transmits an on-the-spot measures result information received from the user terminal to the control center(130).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유비쿼터스 센서네트워크를 이용한 대기오염 관리 기술에 관한 것으로, 각종 상황 및 상태를 측정하는 센서노드들과, 상기 센서노드들을 포함하는 센서네트워크와, 상기 측정된 정보를 관리하는 관제센터와, 상기 관제센터로의 송수신 정보를 구성하는 메시지 센터와, 상기 메시지 센터로부터와 상황정보를 송수신하는 사용자 단말기로 구성된 대기오염 관리 시스템 상에서, 대기오염 관리 기술에 관한 것으로, 대기오염 모니터링 관리 지역에 설치된 센서노드들을 이용하여 각종 대기오염 물질을 측정하고, 센서노드의 위치정보, 상태정보 및 주변 환경 정보들을 측정하며, 상기 센서노드들로부터 측정된 정보들을 관제센터로 전송하고, 상기 관제센터에 수신된 정보들을 토대로 대기오염물질의 배출상황을 실시간 모니터링 및 원격 관리하며, 상기 검토 결과 기준치 이상의 오염상황 또는 현장 조치가 필요한 사항이 감지되었다면, 메시지 센터로 이상감지 결과를 전달하고, 상기 메시지 센터에서는 전달받은 이상감지 정보를 해당지역 주민과 현장 작업자의 사용자 단말기들로 전송하며, 상기 사용자 단말기에서 전송된 조치사항 결과 정보를 메시지 센터에서 수신하여 관제센터로 전달하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 센서노드를 이용하여 현장의 설치장비를 소형화하고, 측정 지점수의 확장에 편리하여 시스템 구성에 소요되는 시간을 절감할 수 있으며, 현장의 센서 네트워크와 원격의 관제센터간의 양방향 통신을 통해 현장 대응력을 높여 현장상황에 신속히 대처할 수 있다. 또한, 대기오염물질 배출상황을 실시간 모니터링하며, 대기오염  관리 및 분석의 정확도와 신뢰도를 높일 수 있다. 
       
     USN(Ubiquitous Sensor Network), 대기오염, 센서노드, 관제센터(도시통합운영센터), 사용자 단말

title_en: Disaster information collection device, system and program, and its method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To widely collect information on damage with high reliability in collecting disaster information.  <P>SOLUTION: This disaster information collection system uses a disaster information collection server, which is provided with: a damage information acquiring part for acquiring information about damage, such as images, video data and text data of a damaged situation input from an information providing terminal; a location information acquiring part for acquiring a damage location and information of a damage location acquiring means from location information embedded in the images and the video data, and an address, map coordinates or latitude and longitude information input from the information providing terminal, and acquiring a report location and information of a location acquiring method from an IP address of the information providing terminal, an identification parameter, and the address, the map coordinates or the latitude and longitude information input from the information providing terminal; and an information reliability calculating part for calculating the reliability of the information about the damage from a relation of the damage location and the report location, or the like.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System for assisting control of rescuing medical services, server, and mobile device
abstract_en: A mobile device and server as an integrated emergency information system. The server includes a main control unit; a display control unit producing screen data to control display on the mobile device; a time stamp acquisition unit detecting an event from the mobile device and acquiring a time stamp; an information registration unit receiving information registration; an index production unit producing prescribed indexes based on the registered information and the acquired time stamp; and a unit for determining the degree of emergency and severity of illness or injury based on the registered information and a “performance standard on transportation and acceptance of a sick or injured person” determined by each municipality. The determining unit displays candidates for transportation to a medical institution corresponding to specific diseases, as a list based on the degree of emergency and severity and a list determined by the municipality if a specific disease is anticipated.

title_en: Video monitoring service method
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An image monitoring service method is provided to comprise image monitoring information with respect to a monitoring region with video monitoring information and image monitoring information, thereby acquiring information with high definition with respect to a monitoring target. CONSTITUTION: A detection camera control module of a controller continuously operates a detection camera and detects a vehicle by receiving recorded image information from the detection camera(300). The detection camera records the front or rear side of a vehicle which enters a monitoring region and detects a license plate from the recorded image information(302). The detection camera control module of the controller comprises the detected license plate, the recorded image information of a license plate region, and license plate information with an actual vehicle position(304). The detection camera control module transmits license plate information and a synchronizing signal to a wide angle camera control module(306).
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르는 영상감시 서비스 방법은, 감시 영역으로 진입 또는 이탈하는 차량의 전면 또는 후면에 대해 촬상을 이행하고, 그 촬상에 따른 검지 촬상정보로부터 차량을 검지하는 단계; 상기 차량이 검지되면, 상기 감시영역 전체에 대해 촬상한 광각 촬상정보에서, 상기 검지 촬상정보로부터 차량 번호판이 검지된 위치에 대응되는 광각 촬상정보의 위치에 존재하는 대상을 검지된 차량으로 결정하고, 상기 감시영역 전체에 대해 촬상한 광각 촬상정보들로 구성되는 동영상정보 중 일부 프레임 전체 또는 일부 프레임 중 상기 검지된 차량 위치영역에 대한 정지영상정보, 시각정보, 검지된 차량에 대한 식별정보, 상기 검지된 차량에 대한 특징정보, 상기 검지한 차량이 상기 감시 영역에서 이동한 이동경로 추적정보, 이동경로 추적에 따른 상황정보 중 하나 이상을 포함하는 헤더와 상기 동영상정보를 결합하여 영상감시정보를 생성하여 외부로 전송하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention monitoring device, which comprises at least one field fire prevention monitoring device, wherein the field fire prevention monitoring device is respectively in communication connection with a base layer monitoring processing center and an upper layer monitoring processing center, and the base layer monitoring processing center and the upper layer monitoring processing center are in communication connection. The forest fire prevention monitoring device has the advantages that workers of the upper layer monitoring processing center carry out fire prevention monitoring and control on image information, the missed report of fire disaster information of the base layer monitoring processing center is avoided, in addition, the upper layer monitoring processing center can correct information transmitted by a first storage unit and a second storage unit through a processor, when the information received by the first storage unit and the information received by the second storage unit are inconsistent, the inconsistent information is stored in an abnormal information storage unit, in addition, a warning device is started for reminding the workers, the fire disaster condition and the work condition of the base layer monitoring center can be further monitored, and the missed report of the fire disaster condition and the work careless omission of the base layer monitoring center are avoided.
assignees: SICHUAN HAIPU IND TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Workflow-based quick response system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a workflow-based quick response system and application of the system in a mobile production line of airplane general assemblies. The system comprises an abnormal information obtaining module, an information classification and confirmation module, an early warning information releasing module and a response information synchronizing module, wherein the abnormal information obtaining module captures and submits abnormal information based on a mixed information capturing mechanism; the information classification and confirmation module comprehensively analyzes, determines and processes the abnormal information based on a quick response workflow; according to information generated in the quick response workflow, the early warning information releasing module displays early warning information via different early warning display devices; and the response information synchronizing module is connected with the early warning information releasing module via serial ports to query and update information in the quick response workflow. The system can be used to display, manage and monitor different production emergency information in the airplane assembling process, can help relevant departments take measures rapidly to decrease direct man-hour consumption in assembling, eliminates delay in production process, improves product quality, and finally realizes the requirement of zero-latency production.

title_en: Supplementary Information Supplying Device using Radion Paging System and Method thereof
title_ko: 무선호출시스템을 이용한 부가정보 제공장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a supplementary information providing apparatus using a radio paging system and a method thereof and, more specifically, to an apparatus and method using an existing radio paging system for providing supplementary information on weather, disaster information, traffic information, streetlight control, control regarding the management of renewable energy generation, etc. To achieve this, the apparatus includes: a supplementary information providing unit which consists of a supplementary information generator and a supplementary information encoder, and provides encoded supplementary information; a transmitting unit which includes a server to transmit supplementary information to a transmitter in a specific area; and a receiving unit which includes a receiver, a decoder, and an information processing unit to process decoded supplementary information, wherein data frames included in the supplementary information include time stamps indicating the time of the moment a specific area′s address, contents to be transmitted, and supplementary information are transmitted or received. According to the present invention, an existing radio paging system can be used to provide supplementary information without having separate expensive dedicated facilities as a long-wave broadcast, thereby providing nationwide supplementary information to unspecified individuals through an inexpensive transceiver.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선호출시스템을 이용한 부가정보 제공장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 날씨, 재난정보, 도로교통정보, 가로등 제어, 신재생에너지 발전의 관리에 관한 제어 등의 부가정보를 제공하기 위해 현존하는 무선호출시스템(Radio Paging System)을 이용하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 이를 위하여 부가정보 발생기와 부가정보 인코더로 구성되어 인코딩된 부가정보를 제공하는 부가정보 제공부; 특정 지역의 송신기로 부가정보를 전달하는 서버를 포함하는 송신부; 및 수신기, 디코더 및 디코딩된 부가정보를 처리하는 정보처리부를 포함하는 수신부;를 포함하고, 부가정보의 데이터 프레임은 특정 지역의 어드레스, 전달 내용 및 부가정보가 송신 또는 수신되는 순간의 시간을 나타내는 타임스탬프를 포함하는 무선호출시스템을 이용한 부가정보 제공장치를 제공한다. 본 발명에 따르면 부가정보 제공에 장파방송과 같은 고가의 전용시설을 따로 구비하지 않고 현존하는 무선호출시스템을 사용하므로 저렴한 비용의 송수신장치를 통하여 불특정 다수에게 전국적인 부가정보를 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Individual protection service system and method
title_ko: 개인 보호 서비스 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an individual safety guard service system and method, wherein the system comprises: a user terminal for requesting an individual safety guard service by transmitting basic user information and a situation setting message, GPS position information on the terminal and time information, dangerous situation information, and a social safety network code, when an emergency situation occurs; an individual safety guard service server connected to the user terminal through a mobile communications network to provide an individual safety guard service; and a terminal of an institution connected to the individual safety guard service server to be connected to a social safety network. The user terminal uses one terminal from among a smart mobile device, a compact portable device, and a wearable device. When an emergency situation occurs, a user who encounters danger or a disaster presses an emergency button on a terminal to immediately request to the individual safety guard service server, so the emergency situation is transmitted to the terminal of a guardian or an institute linked to the social safety network to quickly respond within a short period of time. Accordingly, the position of the user terminal requesting rescue is tracked, so safety personnel can be immediately dispatched to provide safety.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개인 보호 서비스 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 긴급 상황 발생시, 사용자 기본정보와 상황설정 메시지, 단말기의 GPS 위치 정보와 시각 정보, 위험 상황 정보, 및 사회안전망 코드를 전송하여 개인 보호 서비스를 요청하는 사용자 단말기; 상기 사용자 단말기와 이동통신망을 통해 접속되어 개인 보호 서비스(Individual Safety Guard service)를 제공하는 개인 보호 서비스 서버; 및 상기 개인 보호 서비스 서버와 연결되어 사회 안전망에 연결된 기관의 단말기;를 포함하고, 상기 사용자 단말기는 스마트 모바일 기기, 소형 휴대용 기기, 또는 웨어러블 기기 중 어느 하나의 단말기를 사용한다.  
긴급 상황 발생시, 위험이나 재난에 처한 사용자는 단말기의 긴급 버튼을 눌러 개인 보호 서비스 서버로 즉시 요청하여 빠른 시간 내에 신속하게 대응하도록 보호자나 사회안전망과 연동된 기관의 단말기로 위급 상황을 전송하여 구조를 요청한 사용자 단말기의 위치가 추적되며 안전 요원이 즉시 출동하여 안전 조치를 제공받는다.

title_en: Complex fire detector and fire monitoring system comprising the same
title_ko: 복합 화재 감지기 및 이를 포함하는 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a complex fire detector, and a fire monitoring system comprising the same. The complex fire detector of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit which includes a temperature sensor which transmits a temperature detecting signal by detecting temperature, a flame sensor which transmits a flame detecting signal by detecting flame, and a smoke sensor which transmits a smoke detecting signal by detecting smoke; a control unit which complexly analyzes the detecting signals transmitted by the sensors constituting the sensor unit to determine whether a fire incident occurs or not; and a communications unit which communicates with external devices according to the control of the control unit. According to the present invention, data collected through various sensors installed in a monitoring site is complexly analyzed according to a determination criterion appropriately set for an environment of the monitoring site, thereby improving accuracy and reliability of determination on whether a fire incident occurs or not.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 복합 화재 감지기 및 이를 포함하는 화재 감시 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 복합 화재 감지기는 온도를 감지하여 온도 감지신호를 전송하는 온도 센서, 불꽃을 감지하여 불꽃 감지신호를 전송하는 불꽃 센서 및 연기를 감지하여 연기 감지신호를 전송하는 연기 센서를 포함하는 센서부와, 상기 센서부를 구성하는 센서들이 전송하는 감지신호들을 복합적으로 분석하여 화재의 발생 여부를 판단하는 제어부 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 외부와의 통신을 수행하는 통신부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 감시 현장에 설치된 각종 센서들을 통해 수집한 데이터들을 감시 현장의 환경에 적합하게 설정된 판단 기준에 따라 복합적으로 분석함으로써, 화재의 발생 여부에 대한 판단의 정확도와 신뢰도를 향상시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Preparing and Implementing Emergency Response Plans
abstract_en: A system and computer implemented method for implementing an emergency response plan in real time includes the steps of electronically providing an emergency plan flow chart including action items that a user must progress through and complete in real time during an emergency incident, and electronically time stamping the completed action items of the emergency plan flow chart as the user progresses through the emergency plan flow chart during the emergency incident. The user can add notes to the time-stamped competed action items and can save an incident record for the emergency incident record as either an actual emergency incident or a drill.

title_en: System, method, and apparatus for incident reporting
abstract_en: A system for reporting incidents includes at least one server having circuitry configured to receive incident report information from at least one external device including at least one of a location, environment, suspect information, victim information, and type of incident. A severity level for an incident is determined based on the incident report information, and a reporter trustworthiness score is determined based on at least one of the incident report information and reporter profile data. The circuitry receives corroboration reports from at least one additional external device when the reporter trustworthiness score is less than or equal to a predetermined trustworthiness threshold and detects a false report based on the one or more corroboration reports. Incident trends are determined based on at the incident report information and the corroboration reports, the incident report information is output based on the severity level of the incident and the incident report information.

title_en: Backup, Archive and Disaster Recovery Solution with Distributed Storage over Multiple Clouds
abstract_en: This invention is a software application utilizing distributed storage systems to provide backup, archive and disaster recovery (BCADR) functionality across multiple clouds. The multi-cloud aware BCADR application and distributed storage systems are utilized together to prevent data lost and to provide high availability in disastrous incidents. Data deduplication reduces the storage required to store many backups. Reference counting is utilized to assist in garbage collection of staled data chunks after removal of staled backups.

title_en: Earthquake emergency information screening and evaluating system and system in a kind of social networks
abstract_en: The present invention provides Earthquake emergency information screening and evaluating system and system in a kind of social networks, and methods described includes：The Earthquake emergency information in social networks is obtained, word segmentation processing is carried out to the Earthquake emergency information by NLPIR Chinese automatic word-cuts, and the Earthquake emergency information is filtered by theme dictionary；The Earthquake emergency information after filtering is classified using grader；According to information evaluation index system, trust evaluation is carried out to the sorted Earthquake emergency information and critical degree is evaluated.Method provided by the invention, by carrying out filtering screening to substantial amounts of Earthquake emergency information, and information is classified, the confidence level to information and critical degree are evaluated simultaneously, allow the valuable emergency information in social networks effectively to serve the condition of a disaster and study and judge and rescue guarantee, improve the ageing and accuracy of earthquake disaster emergency service.

title_en: A kind of pipe gallery fire alarm method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of pipe gallery fire alarm method and system.The described method includes: obtaining environmental monitoring data in pipe gallery；Data compression is carried out to environmental monitoring data, obtains environmental monitoring compressed data；Classifying and dividing is carried out to environmental monitoring compressed data, obtains multiple subdata bases；Each subdata base is scanned respectively using Apriori algorithm, obtains Frequent Item Sets；The corresponding one or more Frequent Item Sets of each subdata base；The corresponding one group of correlation rule of each Frequent Item Sets；Calculate the confidence level of each Frequent Item Sets；The corresponding correlation rule of Frequent Item Sets that confidence level is greater than default confidence level is determined as Strong association rule；Judge whether to generate warning information according to Strong association rule；If so, generating warning information, and issued warning signal according to warning information.The present invention can be improved the accuracy of early warning, greatly reduce the generation of piping lane fire incident.

title_en: Security service system and emergency bell apparatus applied to the same
title_ko: 보안 서비스 시스템 및 이에 적용되는 비상벨 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security service system and an emergency bell device applied thereto, and more specifically, to a security service system, which assists in accurately grasping the position of a user in an emergency situation of the user through the communication between an emergency bell device and a user terminal, and effectively protects the user by preventing the user from leaving a photographing range of a camera on the basis of the assistance, and the emergency bell device applied thereto. The present invention can support the user terminal located at a distance from the emergency bell device to transmit emergency information according to the emergency situation to the emergency bell device such that the user in the emergency situation can easily transmit the emergency situation. The emergency bell device, receiving the emergency information via short-range communication, can record an image by photographing the user in the emergency situation while outputting a voice for protecting the user in the emergency situation, can compensate for an error according to location information transmitted from the user terminal through distance measurement by means of the short-range communication between the emergency bell device and the user terminal such that an actual location of the user carrying the user terminal can be accurately included in a photographing range of a camera unit, thereby improving the reliability and accuracy of imaging for user protection.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보안 서비스 시스템 및 이에 적용되는 비상벨 장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 비상벨 장치와 사용자 단말 사이의 통신을 통해 사용자의 비상 상황시 사용자의 위치가 정확히 파악되도록 지원하고 이를 기반으로 사용자가 카메라의 촬영 범위를 벗어나지 않도록 하여 효과적으로 사용자를 보호하도록 지원하는 보안 서비스 시스템 및 이에 적용되는 비상벨 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 비상벨 장치와 이격된 거리에 위치한 사용자 단말에서 비상 상황에 따른 비상 정보를 비상벨 장치로 전송할 수 있도록 지원하여 비상 상황에 처한 사용자가 용이하게 비상 상황을 전달할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있으며, 이를 통해 비상 정보를 근거리 통신을 통해 수신한 비상벨 장치에서 비상 상황에 처한 사용자를 보호하기 위한 음성을 출력하는 동시에 비상 상황에 처한 사용자를 촬영하여 영상을 기록할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 사용자 단말로부터 전송되는 위치 정보에 따른 오차를 비상벨 장치와 사용자 단말 사이의 근거리 통신을 통한 거리 측정을 통해 보상하여 사용자 단말을 소지한 사용자의 실제 위치가 카메라부의 촬영 범위 내에 정확하게 포함되도록 하여 사용자 보호를 위한 영상 촬영의 신뢰도 및 정확도를 높이는 효과가 있다.

title_en: dimming control system based multimedia information fusion
title_ko: 방재기능이 구비된 멀티미디어 정보융합 기반 디밍제어 스마트 조명 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dimming control smart lighting system capable of automatically controlling brightness of lighting in accordance with the kind of object appearing nearby and, more specifically, to a multimedia information fusion-based dimming control smart lighting system with a disaster prevention function, which fuses image, audio, and object information to determine the kind of object with high reliability to control dimming of lighting. According to the present invention, the multimedia information fusion-based dimming control smart lighting system with a disaster prevention function comprises: a group lamp; a dimming controller controlling brightness of the group lamp; a camera acquiring image information around the group lamp; an audio recorder acquiring audio information around the group lamp; a PIR sensor acquiring object information of an object appearing around the group lamp; an information analysis module including an image analysis unit analyzing the image information of the camera, an audio analysis module analyzing the audio information of the audio recorder, and an object analysis unit analyzing the object information of the PIR sensor; a fused determination module using analysis results of the information analysis module to determine the kind of the appearing object; a controller adjusting the brightness of the group lamp through the dimming controller in accordance with the determination result of the fused determination module; an environmental information sensor group including a radioactivity sensor detecting radioactive fallout, a fine dust sensor detecting fine dust, an earthquake sensor detecting earthquakes, and a wind speed sensor detecting wind speed; a disaster analysis module analyzing environmental information detected by the environmental information sensor group; and broadcasting equipment and a signboard outputting disaster information in accordance with an analysis result of the disaster analysis module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 근처에 출현한 객체의 종류에 따라 조명의 밝기가 자동으로 조절되는 디밍제어 스마트 조명 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 영상정보, 오디오정보 및 객체정보를 융합하여 객체의 종류를 고신뢰도로 판단하여 조명의 디밍을 제어하는 방재기능이 구비된 멀티미디어 정보융합 기반 디밍제어 스마트 조명 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 방재기능이 구비된 멀티미디어 정보융합 기반 디밍제어 스마트 조명 시스템은 집단 조명등; 상기 집단 조명등의 밝기를 조절하는 디밍제어기; 상기 집단 조명등 주변의 영상정보를 취득하는 카메라; 상기 집단 조명등 주변의 오디오정보를 취득하는 오디오 레코더; 상기 집단 조명등 주변에 출현한 객체의 객체정보를 취득하는 PIR센서; 상기 카메라의 영상정보를 분석하는 영상분석부, 상기 오디오 레코더의 오디오정보를 분석하는 오디오분석부, 상기 PIR센서의 객체정보를 분석하는 객체분석부를 포함하는 정보분석모듈; 상기 정보분석모듈의 분석결과들을 이용해 출현한 객체의 종류를 판별하는 융합판별모듈; 상기 융합판별모듈의 판별결과에 따라 상기 디밍제어기를 통해 상기 조명등의 밝기를 조절하는 컨트롤러; 방사선 낙진을 감지하는 방사선센서, 미세먼지를 감지하는 미세먼지센서, 지진을 감지하는 지진센서, 풍속을 감지하는 풍속센서를 포함하는 환경정보센서군; 상기 환경정보센서군이 감지하는 환경정보를 분석하는 재난재해분석모듈; 상기 재난재해분석모듈의 분석결과에 따라 재난정보를 송출하는 방송장비와 전광판;을 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Situational awareness systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods for computer-aided, session-based operational and organizational responses to asynchronously occurring events. A “session” is a collection of client-server connections, each client connection being an endpoint device in a pool of devices under the control of the members of a defined operational response team cooperating to address an event. The session provides an organizational framework for information sharing, including using context roles to identify the proper recipients for data and messages. The information and data is shared to participating recipients in the session in real-time as the operational response is conducted, and as new data and information is generated, that data is added to the session with a timestamp. Once the response is concluded, the sessions can be closed, encapsulating the data, which can then be “played” back to re-experience the response as it played out, such as for audit, analysis, and review purposes.

title_en: Time delay performance analysis method for continuous backoff freezing in vehicle-mounted communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a time delay performance analysis method for continuous backoff freezing in vehicle-mounted communication, wherein the continuous backoff freezing condition is considered in a data packet time delay calculation method. In the technique of the invention, firstly, a Markov backoff process is converted into a linear system in a Z domain, priority classification is carried out on emergency information and conventional information, MAC layer service process modeling is carried out on two queues by utilizing a probability mother function of backoff time and a probability mother function of transmission time, then a continuous backoff freezing Z domain model is established by adopting a Meisen formula, a backoff counter is calculated to reduce a required average time, and finally a performance parameter is calculated based on an iteration method: the latency of the data packet.

title_en: System for providing visual information for passengers in railway vehicle in real time
abstract_en: One embodiment provides a system for providing visual information for passengers between an operation center and a railway vehicle that are connected by an LTE-R network. The real-time visual information provision system for railway vehicle passengers includes: a service operation server located in the operation center to transmit image information, station guide information, a first application for displaying the image information, and a second application for displaying the station guide information to a railway vehicle through the LTE-R network; a real-time transmission server located in the operation center to transmit emergency information to the railway vehicle through the LTE-R network; and an integrated control device located in the railway vehicle and including an application driving unit receiving data on the image information, data on the station guide information, and data on the emergency information to display the image information by executing the first application and display the station guide information by executing the second application, and an application driving control unit for controlling the application driving unit such that the emergency information is displayed in real time together with the image information and the station guide information when the emergency information is received.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 LTE-R 네트워크로 연결된 운영센터와 철도차량 사이에서 승객용 시각정보를 제공하는 시스템에 있어서,  상기 운영센터에 위치하고, 영상정보, 역안내정보, 상기 영상정보를 현시하기 위한 제1 어플리케이션 및 상기 역안내정보를 현시하기 위한 제2 어플리케이션을 상기 LTE-R 네트워크를 통해 상기 철도차량으로 전송하는 서비스운영서버; 상기 운영센터에 위치하고, 긴급정보를 상기 LTE-R 네트워크를 통해 상기 철도차량으로 전송하는 실시간전송서버;  및 상기 철도차량에 위치하고, 상기 영상정보에 대한 데이터, 상기 역안내정보에 대한 데이터 및 상기 긴급정보에 대한 데이터를 수신하고, 상기 제1 어플리케이션을 실행하여 상기 영상정보를 현시하고 상기 제2 어플리케이션을 실행하여 상기 역안내정보를 현시하는 어플리케이션구동부 및, 상기 긴급정보가 수신되면 상기 영상정보 및 상기 역안내정보와 함께 상기 긴급정보를 실시간으로 현시하도록 상기 어플리케이션구동부를 제어하는 어플리케이션구동제어부를 포함하는 통합제어장치를 포함하는 철도차량 승객용 시각정보 실시간 제공시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: A controlling method of system for broadcasting emergency circumstances
abstract_en: The present invention provides an emergency evacuation broadcasting system using a terminal device for emergency evacuation broadcasting even considering distributed evacuation to prevent the evacuation of occupants from being drawn to one side even by dynamically checking an evacuation situation of occupants. The system includes: a server (100) for controlling the entire system including detecting occupants and displaying disaster information; and a plurality of emergency evacuation broadcasting terminal devices (200) for detecting occupants and displaying disaster information together with the server, wherein the terminal device (200) transmits the occupant information data for each floor and each room to the server (100), the server (100) broadcasts an audio signal through a speaker line to the terminal device (200) in normal times, but in an emergency, transmits a voice signal for evacuation guidance and evacuation information, and transmits evacuation guidance and evacuation information text data by directly converting to network audio broadcasting in a wired/wireless manner when a problem occurs in the speaker line due to a disaster situation, and the terminal device (200) broadcasts an audio signal input from the server (100) through the speaker line in normal times, but in an emergency, receives the evacuation guide visual information and the voice signal for the evacuation information from the server (100) and outputs audiovisually.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 재실자들의 대피 상황까지도 동적으로 파악하여, 대피 중인 재실자들이 한쪽으로 몰리는 상황이 미연에 방지되도록 분산 대피까지 고려한 비상상황 대피 방송용 단말장치를 이용한 비상상황 대피 방송 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것으로, 재실 인원 감지 및 재난 정보 표시를 포함한 전체 시스템을 제어하는 서버(100); 및 상기 서버와 함께 재실 인원 감지 및 재난 정보 표시를 행하는 복수 개의 비상상황 대피 방송용 단말장치(200); 로 이루어지며, 상기 단말장치(200)는 상기 서버(100)로 각 층별 및 실별 인원 정보 데이터를 전송하고, 상기 서버(100)는 상기 단말장치(200)로 평시에는 스피커 선로를 통해 오디오 신호를 방송하나, 비상시에는 대피 안내 및 대피 정보에 대한 음성 신호를 전송하게 되고, 재난 상황으로 인하여 스피커 선로에 문제가 발생하였을 시에는 직접 유무선 방식으로 네트워크 오디오 방송으로 전환하여 대피 안내 및 대피 정보 문자 데이터를 전송하게 되며, 상기 단말장치(200)는 상기 서버(100)로부터 평시에는 스피커 선로를 통해 입력되는 오디오 신호를 방송하며 비상시에는 상기 서버(100)로부터 대피 안내 시각 정보 및 대피 정보에 대한 음성 신호를 전송받아 시청각적으로 출력하게 되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for providing personalized disaster information
title_ko: 개인맞춤형 재난정보 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a device which include actual situation information on a personalized region-of-interest in basic disaster information to regenerate and transmit the same, in order to overcome the existing limitation which cannot effectively respond to a disaster since people becomes indifferent to disaster information by unilaterally transmitting the same disaster information without considering individual interests in transmission of disaster information to individuals through a mobile communication network. The method of the present invention collects and manages information on a region of interest of an individual in advance during normal times to generate disaster information corresponding to various interests of individuals, and collects, analyzes, and manages information on various meters and sensors installed in the region of interest together. When an emergency or urgent disaster occurs or is predicted and disaster information is provided, information collected in a region of interest of an individual is combined with basic disaster information to transmit personalized disaster information. Accordingly, the interest and reliability of people on disaster information increase, and rapid and safe preparation and respond are supported when a disaster occurs, such that human, material, and economic damage can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 종래의 재난정보를 이동통신망을 통해 개인에게 전달함에 있어서 개인의 관심사를 고려하지 않고 일방적이고 동일한 재난정보로 전달함으로써 국민들이 재난정보에 무관심해짐으로써 효과적으로 재난에 대응할 수 없었던 한계점을 극복하기 위한 것으로, 기본 재난정보에 개인맞춤형 관심지역의 실제 상황 정보를 포함하여 재생성 후 전달하는 방법 및 그에 따른 장치이다. 본 발명에서는 다양한 개인들의 관심에 부합하는 재난정보를 생성하기 위해서 평상시에 미리 개인의 관심지역에 대한 정보를 수집하여 관리하고, 관심 지역에 설치된 다양한 계측기 및 센서 정보를 함께 수집, 분석 관리하는 방법을 제시한다. 위급 또는 긴급한 재난이 발생 또는 예측되어 재난정보가 제공될 때, 개인 관심지역에서 수집된 정보를 기본 재난정보와 결합하여 사용자 맞춤형 재난정보를 전달한다. 이를 통해 국민들의 재난정보에 대한 관심 및 신뢰도를 증가시키고 재난 발생시 신속하고 안전하게 대비 및 대응할 수 있도록 지원함으로써 인적, 물적, 경제적 피해를 최소화하는 효과가 예측된다.

title_en: Disaster Information Screening System and Screen Metood to analyze disaster message information on social media using disaster weights
title_ko: 재난 가중치를 이용하여 소셜미디어의 재난 메시지 정보를 분석하는 재난정보 선별시스템 및 선별방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster information screening system that analyzes disaster message information on social media using disaster weights, wherein a control server (10) having an arithmetic function and a database (20) storing message information on social media are connected to a network, and the control server analyzes the message information. The control server (10) includes: a data collection unit (100) that collects messages from social media; a class classification unit (200) that learns the collected message information, calculates a disaster weight value, which is a vector value between words included in the message, and classifies the messages into preset classes using the calculated disaster weight value; a subject grouping unit (300) that clusters message information classified into the same class by subject; and a reliability calculator (400) for calculating reliability scores between pieces of message information belonging to the same subject cluster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 연산기능을 가진 제어서버(10) 및 소셜미디어 상의 메시지 정보가 저장된 데이터베이스(20)가 네트워크로 연결되고, 제어서버가 상기 메시지 정보를 분석하는 재난정보 선별시스템으로서, 제어서버(10)는 소셜미디어에서 메시지를 수집하는 데이터 수집부(100); 수집된 메시지 정보를 학습하여, 메시지에 포함된 단어 간의 벡터값인 재난가중치를 산출하고, 산출된 재난 가중치를 이용하여 메시지를 기 설정된 클래스 별로 분류하는 클래스 분류부(200); 동일 클래스로 분류된 메시지 정보를 주제별로 군집하는 주제 군집부(300); 및 동일 주제 군집에 속하는 메시지 정보간의 신뢰도 점수를 산출하는 신뢰도 산출부(400)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 가중치를 이용하여 소셜미디어의 재난 메시지 정보를 분석하는 재난정보 선별시스템이다.

title_en: Incident location reporting using isodistance
abstract_en: In a method for calculating a location of a traffic incident a processor receives a first alarm message. The alarm message has a device identification, an event time stamp indicating detection of an incident, and a first distance vector. The processor calculates first isodistance information from the first distance vector and receives a second alarm message that has the device identification, the event time stamp, and a second distance vector. The processor calculates a second isodistance information for the second alarm message, and calculates a location of the incident based on the first isodistance information and the second isodistance information.

title_en: Post-vehicular incident reconstruction report
abstract_en: The disclosure herein describes systems and methods for generating a post-vehicular incident report. In some examples, the system includes receiving a notification from a user device indicating the user device has been involved in an incident, obtaining incident data from the user device that includes a timestamp and location data, retrieving third-party incident data corresponding to the timestamp and the location data received in the incident data, generating a timeline of the incident based on the obtained incident data from the user device and the retrieved third-party incident data, the generated timeline including events occurring prior to the incident and events occurring after the incident, generating a report of the incident based on the generated timeline, the obtained incident data, and the retrieved third-party incident data, the report including the timeline, and outputting the generated report to the user device and at least one of a plurality of approved devices.

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating disaster notification message, method for providing disaster information using the same
title_ko: 재난알림메시지 생성장치 및 그 방법과, 이를 이용한 재난정보 제공방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 본 발명의 재난알림메시지 생성장치 및 그 방법과, 이를 이용한 재난정보 제공방법은 재난을 전문적으로 감시하는 기관의 재난감시서버로부터 수집된 재난발생데이터를 근거로 하여 재난알림메시지를 생성함으로써, 재난알림메시지의 신뢰도를 향상시킬 수 있고, 재난 종류 및 재난의 재난등급별로 설정된 행동요령정보를 미리 저장하고, 상기 재난감시서버로부터 재난발생데이터가 수신되면, 재난의 종류 및 재난의 재난등급별로 미리 설정된 다양한 행동요령정보를 포함하는 서술형 재난알림메시지를 생성함으로써, 재난알림메시지를 수신한 사용자가 재난에 적절히 대처할 수 있도록 하고, 재난정보를 간략하게 표출하되, 재난등급별로 일부영역의 색상을 다르게 표출하여 인지도를 향상시킨 팝업형 재난알림메시지를 추가로 더 생성한 후, 상기 팝업형 재난알림메시지를 우선적으로 표출하도록 함으로써, 재난알림효과를 극대화할 수 있고, 미리 설정된 소정 시간 이후의 미래예측정보를 반영한 재난알림메시지를 생성하여 제공함으로써, 재난알림메시지를 수신한 사용자가 해당 재난에 대하여 보다 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Event-driven cultural relic building fire safety grading early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an event-driven cultural relic building fire safety grading early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring fire safety related data of the cultural relic building in real time, adding a timestamp to the fire safety related data, and adding the fire safety related data added with the timestamp into a pre-established message queue; and judging whether each piece of fire safety related data in the message queue is abnormal event data or not by using a complex event processing engine, if so, storing the abnormal event data into an abnormal event database as a new entry, and grouping all the abnormal event data according to the incident places related to all the obtained abnormal event data in the abnormal event database so as to obtain a plurality of abnormal event sets. The invention can solve the technical problem that the prior fire fighting equipment early warning method often causes misjudgment and even neglects the job due to insufficient experience of the civil insurance personnel, thereby causing a great accident.

title_en: Method and apparatus for analyasing indoor building disaster information using point cloud data and visual information from ground survey robot
title_ko: 지상조사 로봇의 점군 자료와 시각정보를 이용한 실내건물 재난정보 분석 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for analyzing disaster information of a facility, which is performed by a computer device connected to a survey robot, includes the following steps of: moving a position of the survey robot to a first position for information analysis on the facility, using a sensor module provided in the survey robot, and including at least one of a lidar sensor, an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensor, and at least one vision sensor; acquiring sensing information corresponding to the first position based on Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM); identifying a facility segment of an indoor space based on the sensing information; in response to the facility segment, acquiring visual crack identification information analyzed from vision image information of the sensing information, and crack depth change information determined based on depth sensing information corresponding to the visual crack identification information; estimating and calculating the degree of damage to the facility segment, depending on whether a crack exists and the scale of the crack, which are acquired based on the visual crack identification information and the crack depth change information; and constituting facility information analysis result data of the facility segment based on the degree of damage, outputting the data to at least one device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 조사로봇과 연결된 컴퓨터 장치에 의해 실행되는 시설물의 재난정보 분석 방법에 있어서, 상기 조사로봇에 구비되며, 라이다 센서, IMU(Inertial Measurement Unit) 센서 및 하나 이상의 비전 센서 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 센서 모듈을 이용하여, 상기 시설물의 정보 분석을 위한 상기 조사로봇의 위치를 제1 위치로 이동시키는 단계; 상기 제1 위치에 대응하는 센싱 정보를 SLAM(Simultaneous Localization And Mapping) 기반으로 획득하는 단계; 상기 센싱 정보에 기초하여 실내 공간의 시설물 세그먼트를 식별하는 단계; 상기 시설물 세그먼트에 대응하여, 상기 센싱 정보의 비전 영상 정보로부터 분석되는 시각적 크랙 식별 정보와, 상기 시각적 크랙 식별 정보에 대응하는 깊이 센싱 정보에 의해 판별되는 크랙 깊이 변화 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 시각적 크랙 식별 정보 및 상기 크랙 깊이 변화 정보에 기초하여 획득되는 크랙의 유무 및 크랙의 규모에 따라, 상기 시설물 세그먼트의 손상 정도를 추정 연산하는 단계; 및 상기 손상 정도에 기초한 상기 시설물 세그먼트의 시설물 정보 분석 결과 데이터를 구성하여, 하나 이상의 디바이스로 출력하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Unmanned plane path collaborative planning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for collaborative planning of unmanned aerial vehicle paths, which comprise the steps of taking the sum of the transmission consumption time of the minimum unmanned aerial vehicle when disaster information is collected and the reciprocal of the freshness of the disaster information collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle as an optimization target, and constructing an objective function under a preset constraint condition; constructing a deep reinforcement learning model corresponding to the objective function and a reward function of the deep reinforcement learning model; according to the method, a deep reinforcement learning model is solved according to a reward function, a flight strategy of the unmanned aerial vehicle under the conditions of minimum transmission consumption time and maximum freshness is obtained, timeliness and reliability of information acquisition and transmission are guaranteed through a unmanned aerial vehicle path collaborative planning mode based on deep reinforcement learning, overall efficiency of a system is improved, and the flight strategy of the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized through data freshness of information acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that accuracy of emergency response and decision making is improved.

title_en: Flood disaster information management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster information management method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a database unit, a block chain unit and a data application unit; collecting flood disaster information of a flood disaster information monitoring site in real time through a database unit and uploading the flood disaster information to the database; automatically uploading flood disaster information to a blockchain through each network node; updating flood disaster information to blocks of all network nodes through a block chain unit according to a DPOS consensus algorithm and a time stamp; according to qualification of the data demand party, opening data operation authority of flood disaster information; the data operation authority comprises at least one of data query authority, data downloading authority and real-time sharing authority; providing a data operation function of water disaster information for the authority user through the data application unit; the method is beneficial to safely and reliably managing flood disaster information and is convenient for the data provider and the data demander to conduct real-time data interaction. The invention can be widely applied to the technical field of water disaster information management.

title_en: System and method for visualizing situational awareness information for autonomous ship
title_ko: 자율운항선박의 상황인식정보 가시화 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a system and method for visualizing situational awareness information for an autonomous ship, which is configured to visualize situational awareness information generated based on images and various sensor data around the ship during the operation of the autonomous ship and visually display it through a display, etc. The situational awareness information visualization system of an autonomous ship includes: a data collection unit configured to perform processing for collecting situational awareness information including images of the ship's surroundings, various measurement values, and operation data received from a number of cameras installed on the autonomous ship, various measurement sensors, and navigation equipment; a visualization processing unit configured to perform processing for visualizing and visually displaying the situational awareness information collected through the data collection unit; and a display unit configured to perform processing for displaying the situational awareness information visualized by the visualization processing unit. The present invention enables more easily and intuitively checking various information generated during the operation of an autonomous ship.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자율운항선박의 상황인식정보를 가시화하기 위한 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 종래, 일반적으로, 자율운항선박의 운항시 해당 자율운항선박에 탑재되는 카메라와 각종 센서 및 항해장비들을 통해 선박 주변의 영상 및 각종 데이터를 기반으로 상황인식정보를 생성하고 해당 정보를 기반으로 자율운항이 이루어지나, 이러한 상황인식정보를 한눈에 확인할 수 있도록 시각화하여 표시할 수 있는 장치나 방법은 제시된 바 없는 한계가 있었던 종래기술의 자율운항선박 및 운항제어 시스템들의 문제점을 해결하기 위해, 자율운항선박의 운항시 선박 주변의 영상 및 각종 데이터를 기반으로 생성되는 상황인식정보를 가시화하여 디스플레이 등을 통해 시각적으로 표시하는 동시에, 해상 상황에 따라 각각의 데이터에 대한 신뢰도를 판단하고 조정할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써, 자율운항선박의 운항중 생성되는 다양한 정보를 보다 용이하게 직관적으로 확인 가능하며, 그것에 의해, 자율운항선박의 운항시 발생하는 다양한 상황에 대하여 더욱 신속하고 정확하게 현재 상황을 파악할 수 있는 동시에, 고장이나 사고 또는 충돌위험 발생 등과 같은 비상상황시에도 즉각적이고 적절한 상황인식 및 대응이 가능하도록 구성되는 자율운항선박의 상황인식정보 가시화 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Location-based road situation information sharing system
abstract_en: The location-based road situation information sharing system according to the present invention has the effect of minimizing traffic congestion by quickly and accurately sharing road situation information when situations that may cause problems in road traffic, such as construction, occur on the road. Specifically, the present invention has the effect of not only sharing road situation information based on GPS coordinates quickly and with high reliability, but also providing high-accuracy information by reflecting changes in the road situation information over time in real time, and has the effect of allowing a driver to receive notifications about road situation information or report road situation information without any complicated operations during driving. In addition, the present invention has the effect of facilitating cooperation with public institutions related to the corresponding area, assisting in dealing with civil complaints and construction management, and collecting and providing reliable road situation information. Therefore, the present invention has the effect of minimizing traffic congestion on roads and reducing the probability of traffic accidents on roads.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 위치 기반 도로상황정보 공유 시스템은 도로에 공사 등의 도로 통행에 문제를 초래할 수 있는 상황이 발생했을 경우, 이러한 도로상황정보를 신속하고 정확하게 공유하여 교통체증을 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 구체적으로 본 발은 GPS좌표에 따른 도로상황정보를 신속하면서도 신뢰도가 높은 수준으로 공유할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 상기 도로상황정보의 시간에 따른 변경 내용도 실시간으로 반영하여 정확도 높은 정보를 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있으며, 운전 중에도 별도의 복잡한 조작 없이 도로상황정보에 대한 알림을 받거나 도로상황정보를 신고할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 또한 본 발명은 해당 지역과 관련한 공공기관과의 협조가 용이하고, 민원 응대 및 공사 관리에 도움을 줄 수 있으며, 신뢰성 높은 도로상황정보를 수집하여 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 따라서 본 발명은 도로의 교통혼잡을 최소화하며, 도로의 교통사고 확률을 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Alarm platform with aggregated alarm events
abstract_en: A method comprises receiving, by a first computing device, a plurality of events, each event including a timestamp and an indicator that corresponds with a location where the corresponding event occurred. The method comprises generating a list of events that occurred at a particular location. The method comprises chronologically ordering the list of events that occurred at the particular location, thereby producing a chronologically ordered list of events. The method comprises allocating the events in the chronologically ordered list into a plurality of alarm incidents, a particular one of the alarm incidents having allocated thereto events that occurred at the particular location. The method comprises receiving, from a second computing device via a network connection, a request for one or more alarm incidents for the particular location. The method comprises after receiving the request, sending, to the second computing device, via the network connection, the particular alarm incident.

title_en: Emergency information processing method and system for multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for processing emergency information by multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource heterogeneous data flow, geographic position, time stamp and environment perception data through real-time acquisition, carrying out deep association matching and modeling on emergency events to obtain a dynamic emergency event situation model, evaluating and selecting the most suitable emergency resources according to the dynamic emergency event situation model by adopting a resource optimization algorithm to obtain an emergency resource allocation scheme and instant guidance information, updating the state of a patient based on the emergency resource allocation scheme and the instant guidance information, adjusting an emergency strategy and an optimized resource allocation path through geographic information system path planning analysis to obtain a dynamic adjusted emergency flow and an optimized path scheme, integrating various feedback data related to the dynamic adjusted emergency flow and the optimized path scheme, and carrying out post analysis to generate an optimized guide. The technical scheme provided by the application greatly improves the efficiency of first-aid information processing.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: First-aid record safe storage method and system based on blockchain technology
abstract_en: The application provides a first-aid record safe storage method and system based on a blockchain technology. The method comprises the steps of receiving emergency record data generated in an emergency event to obtain emergency record data containing time stamps and geographical position information, utilizing a hash algorithm to convert the emergency record data to construct an untampereable data packet to obtain a data packet containing emergency information authenticity and integrity evidence, automatically checking compliance and authority of the data packet through an intelligent contract to obtain the emergency record data packet which is allowed to be added into a blockchain network, utilizing a distributed consensus algorithm to synchronize among a plurality of nodes and introducing an under-chain computing mechanism to obtain emergency records which are safely and transparently saved under the condition of no centralized management, and providing an access control interface to enable related parties to inquire and verify the emergency records under the condition of following strict privacy protection rules, but not allowing unauthorized modification or deletion operation. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the safety, transparency and traceability of the emergency record.

title_en: Comprehensive risk early warning system based on market big data and credit risks of both transaction parties
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of credit risk analysis, in particular to a comprehensive risk early warning system based on market big data and credit risk of both transaction parties. According to the method, ESG rating, news emotion, geographic liveness, disaster early warning and business financial summary data are comprehensively collected, format alignment and unified timestamp marking are carried out on multi-source heterogeneous data to form a structured market factor flow, multidimensional fusion and efficient integration of market information are achieved on processing logic, instantaneity and sensitivity of credit risk monitoring are improved, quantitative analysis of credit risk text items is carried out based on ESG deviation values, emotion polarities and geographic liveness change rates, and risk accurate matching is carried out by combining geographic positions and disaster information, so that accuracy and sensitivity of risk factor association are directly improved.
assignees: WANLIAN ZHISHU QINGDAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flooding detection device detects water level using ultrasonic waves and flooding information system using the same
title_ko: 초음파를 이용하여 수위를 감지하는 침수 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 침수 정보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flooding detection device for detecting a water level using ultrasonic waves and a flooding information system using the same. The flooding detection device is suitable for constructing a systematic disaster information system by detecting flooding in various aspects in real time with high reliability, including downtown flooding that can occur suddenly every moment due to extreme rainfall and river flooding, and is easy to install and maintain at an initial stage. The present invention comprises: a main body casing having a water storage space filled with water introduced into the inside through a water inlet hole formed in a lower portion, and having a lower end portion fixed to the ground; an ultrasonic water level sensor installed on a ceiling of the water storage space of the main body casing to measure a water level by detecting water filled in the water storage space while oscillating ultrasonic waves downward; and a communication module for transmitting and receiving information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 초음파를 이용하여 수위를 감지하는 침수 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 침수 정보시스템에 관한 것으로, 극한강우, 하천범람으로 시시각각 갑작스럽게 발생할 수 있는 도심 침수를 비롯하여 다양한 양상의 침수에 대해서도 높은 신뢰도를 갖고 실시간으로 감지가 가능하여 체계적인 재난정보 시스템을 구축하는데 적당하며, 초기 설치 및 유지보수에도 용이하도록 한 것이다.  
이러한 본 발명은, 하부에 형성된 물 유입공을 통해 내부로 유입된 물이 차오르는 저수공간을 가지며, 하단부가 지면에 고정되는 본체 케이싱; 상기 본체 케이싱의 저수공간 천정에 설치되어 초음파를 하향 발진하면서 상기 저수공간에서 차오르는 물을 감지하여 수위를 측정할 수 있도록 한 초음파 수위센서; 및 정보를 송수신 하는 통신모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency information management system and method based on mobile internet and two-dimension code
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency information management, and discloses an emergency information management system and method based on a mobile internet and a two-dimension code, wherein the method comprises the following steps of acquiring a unique identifier of equipment from a security chip, combining a precise timestamp with geocoding data, generating a dynamic encryption UUID (user identifier) through a hybrid encryption algorithm, adopting a key derivation technology to ensure that each session key is independent, and finally outputting a standardized encryption identifier; and integrating the encrypted UUID, the time stamp and the metadata of the authority level with the digital signature, and generating a dynamic two-dimensional code containing an ultraviolet mark through serialization coding, error correction enhancement and physical anti-counterfeiting treatment. The invention constructs the end-to-end trusted first-aid information channel through the deep fusion of dynamic data anchoring and multidimensional safety verification, and effectively breaks the information lag and safety defect of the traditional static management mode.

title_en: Disaster site multidimensional image cooperative processing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle-satellite cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster site multidimensional image cooperative processing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle-satellite cooperation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource heterogeneous image data, carrying out space synchronization preprocessing, achieving time stamp correction through constructing a communication delay prediction model, then adopting a segmentation processing strategy driven by boundary evidence intensity, establishing a three-dimensional evaluation system based on time evidence, space evidence and consistency evidence, carrying out differential registration processing on image boundaries, achieving balance between boundary information and continuity under a constraint optimization framework through a boundary continuity constraint propagation mechanism and a sliding window reconstruction technology, carrying out quality perception multidimensional image fusion, and outputting a high-precision disaster situation map and a loss evaluation result. The method solves the technical problems of low image registration precision and ghost boundary generated by boundary fusion under heterogeneous timestamps, and improves the accuracy and reliability of disaster loss assessment.
assignees: GANSU HUIENYUAN EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for distributing emergency broadcast information through digital television
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for distributing emergency broadcast information through a digital television, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, receiving emergency information with release time sent by a relevant platform forming an upper and lower command relationship with the current emergency broadcast platform by the current emergency broadcast platform, S2, matching the emergency information with release time, adding the emergency information into an event stream according to time sequence, S3, judging event state change between the emergency information and the emergency information of a last time stamp based on the upper and lower command relationship, S4, screening the emergency information and the emergency information of the last time stamp according to the event state change, generating updated content and corresponding content display instructions, distributing the updated content and the corresponding content display instructions to the digital television, and enabling the digital television to display the corresponding updated content under the control of the content display instructions.
assignees: SICHUAN KUANGSHI RUANTONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-organizing earthquake early warning method based on emergency information release system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-organizing earthquake early warning method based on an emergency information release system, which particularly relates to the technical field of earthquake early warning, and comprises the steps of acquiring an initial feature vector of an earthquake event and broadcasting the initial feature vector to edge nodes, constructing a local propagation weight and a relay queue by each node based on received information, realizing multi-hop self-organizing propagation path construction, dynamically monitoring local receiving density and relay delay in a propagation process, identifying a signal attenuation area and triggering a cooperative relay request, dispatching available equipment by a central node to construct a temporary relay group, automatically deploying a hot spot communication protocol, improving the information coverage range and transmission reliability, finally constructing a complete propagation topological graph, and calculating response time stamps of each node to evaluate system performance.

title_en: Emergency information instant transmission method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency information instant transmission method and system based on the Internet of things, which comprises the steps of calibrating a sensor network in real time based on a time synchronization algorithm to reduce time delay errors in the emergency information transmission process, filtering encrypted data based on an abnormal data identification and screening algorithm to remove invalid or erroneous data to ensure the accuracy of a diagnosis process, and packaging the calibrated time-stamped emergency data by adopting a layered encryption protocol to ensure the safety of patient privacy in the transmission process.
assignees: THE THIRD XIANGYA HOSPITAL OF CENTRAL SOUTH UNIV

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for connectionless emergency access in non-terrestrial networks using satellites
abstract_en: Disclosed methods and apparatuses provide connectionless emergency access to user terminals (UTs) operating in a satellite-based service area of a non-terrestrial network (NTN). Example advantages include providing for the connectionless emergency access with lightweight or semi- persistent Downlink (DL) signaling used in the satellite-based service area, at least with respect to supporting connectionless emergency accesses. Other advantages include low-latency with respect to transmission of emergency information, and the option of using the same, statically or globally defined resources for the entire service area, even in cases where NTN-based access divides the service area into multiple cells.

title_ko: 재난 정보 투사 기능을 갖는 지능형 시각 경보 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 상황에서 시각적으로 경보 문구와 피난 유도 정보를 제공할 수 있도록 고안된 재난 정보 투사 기능을 갖는 지능형 시각 경보 장치에 관한 것으로, 케이싱; 상기 케이싱 내부에 설치되어, 재난 관련 경보 문구, 피난 유도 정보 또는 안전 안내 이미지를 외부 표면이나 벽면에 투사하는 투사 모듈; 및 상기 투사 모듈의 구동을 제어하고, 외부 재난 감지 센서 또는 재난 정보 수신 모듈과 연동하여 경보 신호에 대응하는 시각 정보를 선택·출력하도록 제어하는 제어 모듈;을 포함한다.
